featured_reviews.name: greta rebello
featured_reviews.review_text: Clean and well maintained facility, very helpful staff's,  always alert lifeguard's, very professional, knowledgeable, encouraging, motivating and most importantly very understanding coaches and a highly alert head coach with an eagle's eye on every student and coach. Like to thank Coach Navdeep for understanding my spine disc buldge, severe Sciatica pain and water phobia issue and training me accordingly starting with simple water exercise. I would like to thank coach Rohit sir too for switching me to breaststroke swimming keeping in mind my repetitive Spine, Sciatica pain and leg cramps issues. featured_reviews.name: Irfan Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I joined the swimming program at Michael Phelps Swimming India, Kohinoor Club Kurla, expecting a professional and hygienic environment, but unfortunately my experience was disappointing.

The biggest concern is cleanliness and hygiene. The washroom areas are not maintained properly and often feel unhygienic. The pool maintenance also needs serious improvement. Additionally, there is no proper shade or sun protection around the pool area, making it uncomfortable during peak daytime sessions.

Another issue is the lack of proper team management and professionalism among some staff members. There seems to be poor coordination between coaches, and arguments or conflicts happening in front of students create an uncomfortable environment. Some coaches also appear uninterested and non-cooperative during sessions, which affects the overall learning experience.

There were also occasions where staff members appeared to consume tobacco products before or during sessions, which created an unpleasant environment due to strong odor and felt highly unprofessional around students and parents.

Communication is another challenge due to language barriers, and overall the atmosphere feels poorly managed for a place that represents such a reputed name.

I hope the management takes these concerns seriously and improves the hygiene, professionalism, discipline, and overall experience for students and parents.

featured_reviews.name: Mohammad Asif Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text: Had an amazing experience learning swimming with Coach Shubhankar Sir! 🏊‍♂️ His coaching style is super patient, motivating, and focused on technique. He pays attention to every detail and helps you overcome your fears in the water. Each session is fun, challenging, and confidence-boosting. Highly recommend him to anyone wanting to improve their swimming skills!

featured_reviews.name: Toufiq Sayed
featured_reviews.review_text:
I opted in for their swimming programme last year and had a good experience overall- very professional and friendly trainers.

However, I wish they'd structure the programme to start by teaching basic survival in water first, instead of directly starting with freestyle and other swimming techniques.

Because midway through the programme I started having neck pain which further led  to the discovery that I had a neck issue since birth but it was passive till my neck started getting engaged a lot as part of learning the swimming techniques.
So I had to stop before I could learn basic survival in water which was my primary goal of joining the programme.

I have been swimming here for some time. According to me there are some pros and cons

Pros:
1. Olympic size swimming pool

3. Location: very near to chembur station, situated in the main chembur market, lot of traveling options bus and rickshaws are easily accessible

4. Cleanliness: water, changing rooms, washrooms are clean and tidy.

Cons:
1. Over Crowded: since it's a bmc operated pool and having a cheaper fee, you will find over crowd at times

3. Waiting period for annual subscription: usually you won't get the subscription easily, there will always be a long waiting list

featured_reviews.review_text: My daughter who is 3 yrs old was enrolled at the pre beginner level 3 months ago, after 21 sessions the staff got completely changed and the students nor the parents were told of this situation. Now the new teachers are teaching again from the basics instead of taking the child's progress ahead. There is no head coach to talk to nor does the head office reply to the emails. I do not recommend this franchise of Micheal Phelps Swimming to anybody.

featured_reviews.name: Supreme Kothari
featured_reviews.review_text:
The idea of personal coaching during a 40-minute session here seems to run entirely on luck—and unfortunately, luck doesn’t favor everyone every day. Like today, for instance—my daughter got a few seconds of attention right at the end, while the coach’s focus remained firmly on a younger child throughout. Maybe there’s a secret lottery system? If so, we’d love to know how to sign up.

Also, during rains (like on 1st June), it’s perfectly normal here for most coaches to simply step out while kids are left to figure things out on their own. Because, of course, why would Michael Phelps’ name imply any higher standard, especially in India?

And yes, batch change chaos is part of life—we get that. But if it regularly eats into actual swimming time, then it stops being "chaos" and starts becoming bad planning.

If there’s some unofficial premium fee that buys actual attention, please do let us know. We'd be happy to pay, instead of just crossing our fingers each time.

We expected the name to come with certain standards. Right now, it feels more like a branding exercise than a coaching one.

featured_reviews.name: kiran karande
featured_reviews.review_text:
“Michael Phelps Swimming Academy at Universal Chembur is an absolute gem for anyone looking to dive into the world of swimming, from beginners to advanced swimmers alike. The facility is meticulously maintained, offering a clean, hygienic environment that’s immediately welcoming and sets the tone for a safe and enjoyable swimming experience. The pool itself is beautifully designed and well-equipped, making it ideal for swimmers of all levels.

The coaching staff is truly top-notch, with well-trained instructors who bring patience, expertise, and personalized attention to each swimmer. The academy follows the Michael Phelps method, ensuring that techniques are taught correctly with a strong focus on form and safety. The coaches are approachable, motivating, and skilled in working with everyone from young children to adults, adapting their approach based on the needs and skill levels of each participant. For those who might be a bit nervous or lack confidence in the water, the coaches are fantastic at building trust and helping swimmers gradually overcome their fears.

The pool’s water quality is exceptional, as it is regularly tested and maintained, ensuring a pleasant swimming experience without the overpowering smell of chlorine that some pools can have. The entire space, from the pool to the changing areas, is kept extremely clean, adding to the sense of professionalism and care that the facility offers.

The management at Universal Chembur has clearly invested in creating a high-quality swimming experience. They provide all necessary amenities, and there’s a strong emphasis on safety, with lifeguards always on duty and clear guidelines for both swimmers and spectators. The academy also offers convenient scheduling options, so whether you’re looking for early morning sessions or evening classes, there’s something to fit a variety of schedules.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Jasmine Banquet at Jolly Gymkhana for a baby shower function.
The banquet has seating for around 100 people and a big stage, which is good for events. However, the ambience was quite average. The lighting was dull, and it felt a bit gloomy. Since the banquet is in the basement, we noticed a musty smell on entering, like it hadn’t been used in a while.

The food area can handle about 50–80 people and the food itself was quite good. Decor was okay, nothing fancy.

One major downside was the washroom on the ground floor — it was stinking and not well-maintained.

Parking is a bit tricky. Outside parking is only for club members, but valet parking is available for other guests.

Overall, it works for small functions but could use better maintenance and lighting for a better experience.

featured_reviews.name: Rahul Chitte
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Chembur Gymkhana is undoubtedly one of the finest gymkhanas in Mumbai. The place exudes elegance with its posh ambiance and well-maintained facilities. The highlight is its massive swimming pool, which is a perfect spot for both relaxation and fitness. The dining setup beside the pool adds a serene and luxurious touch, offering a delightful experience.

The gymkhana also features AC restaurants on both the ground and first floors, serving delicious cuisine that caters to a variety of tastes. The addition of a huge TV screen enhances the overall vibe, making it an excellent venue to unwind or enjoy a game with friends.

For indoor recreation, the card room and billiards room stand out as great spaces to relax and have fun. The crowd here is sorted, elegant, and adds to the overall sophistication of the place.

Chembur Gymkhana is a gem in the city, seamlessly blending leisure, entertainment, and a premium atmosphere. Highly recommended for anyone seeking a refined and comfortable experience.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I attended a wedding here and i must say that the wedding hall was extremely nice.  The cooling and the overall decor of the hall was amazing.  There is sufficient seating arrangement for least 200 people and the caterers (Prathiba) were also good.

The food quality here was top notch especially the non veg starters.  I loved the main course as well.

For car parking there is no space inside, but there was valet services available.  The location is a little bit inside from the Highway but the google maps takes you to the right location.

I would give this place an overall rating of 9/10.

featured_reviews.name: Chirag Warty
featured_reviews.review_text:
it isn't just a gym; it's a multifaceted urban oasis offering something for everyone. From top-notch fitness facilities to refreshing pools and delightful dining options,

State-of-the-Art Equipment:  Pump iron with the latest weight training machines, get your cardio fix with treadmills and ellipticals, or participate in group fitness classes - The Chembur Gymkhana caters to all your fitness needs with its modern and well-maintained equipment.

Spacious and Airy Environment: the gym's spacious layout and fresh atmosphere.  Expect ample space to work out comfortably without feeling crowded.

Expert Trainers:  gym offers qualified trainers who can design personalized workout programs and guide you towards your fitness goals.

Beyond the Gym:

Sparkling Swimming Pools:  Take a refreshing dip in the well-maintained swimming pools, perfect for escaping the summer heat or enjoying a relaxing lap swim.

Squash, Badminton, and More:  The gymkhana offers courts for various indoor sports like squash, badminton, and potentially others.  This provides a fun and social way to stay active.

A Haven for Relaxation:  After a workout or a swim, unwind in the dedicated relaxation areas.  Some might even offer amenities like steam rooms or saunas.

Delicious Dining:

Multiple Restaurants:  The Chembur Gymkhana boasts a variety of on-site restaurants offering diverse cuisines.  Enjoy a post-workout meal, a casual lunch with friends, or even a special occasion dinner.

Family-Friendly Atmosphere:  The gymkhana has areas specifically designed for families, creating a welcoming environment for everyone.

The Chembur Gymkhana offers a comprehensive and exceptional club experience.  Modern fitness facilities, refreshing pools, diverse sports options, and delightful dining options make it a one-stop shop for wellness and leisure.  Whether you're a fitness enthusiast seeking a state-of-the-art gym, a family looking for a place to relax and unwind, or simply someone who enjoys good food and company, The Chembur Gymkhana has something to offer everyone.

This state-of-the-art fitness center promises to elevate your exercise routine to new heights with an exceptional gym facility. Get ready to embark on a transformative journey towards a stronger, healthier, and more confident you!

featured_reviews.name: Mr. Sachin Mandlik
featured_reviews.review_text:
Glorious Fitness By Mr.Prashant Wadekar is a spacious gym located in the Ghatkopar East heart of downtown, catering to a diverse range of fitness enthusiasts from beginners to seasoned athletes.
The staff is incredibly friendly and knowledgeable. They are always willing to assist with any questions and provide valuable fitness advice.
